purpose: Where a Foundation host keeps what. The system disk holds the OS and its packages; everything that grows with data — Docker's volumes and containers, containerd's images, snapshots and build cache — lives on the data disk. scripts/ops/host-docker-data-root.sh moves a running host to this layout and lays out a new one; scripts/ops/host_retention.py measures the disk named here.

containerd.reason: Docker 29 keeps images, their snapshots and the build cache in containerd's image store (driver-type io.containerd.snapshotter.v1), not under Docker's data-root: measured 2026-10-14 on ai-server, /var/lib/docker 21.4 GB and /var/lib/containerd 105 GB. Moving only Docker's data-root would leave five sixths of it on the system disk.

spark_tmp_reason: Every Spark container (compose.lakehouse.yml spark and spark-small) mounts this at /tmp: Spark's default spill directory, Python's tempfile and the JVM's temp files. Without it they wrote into the container's own layer, which lives with Docker on the system disk until the move above has run; 13 of the 18 Spark launches set no spark.local.dir. A job that names its own spark.local.dir (/scratch, already on this disk) keeps it. Mode 1777: the container runs as uid 185 or as the caller's FOUNDATION_PLATFORM_LAKEHOUSE_UID.
time_caps_reason: The live copy runs while every service still serves; past its cap the run stops before anything was stopped and unpauses the DAGs. The stopped copy only carries what changed since, and the services are down while it runs; past its cap the run rolls back. Sized from the 2026-10-14 measurement (124 GiB, mostly containerd snapshots) and the data disk's ~180 MB/s measured on 2026-09-09.
free_space_reason: The copy needs the bytes it copies, and the old trees stay until the owner checks the host: twice the measured size keeps room for both and for growth during the run.
readiness_reason: What the owner looks at after the move, besides every container that ran before running again and every container that was healthy before being healthy again.
